notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.2 Out NOW
notes.content:
Patch 1/0/0/2 

- Adds more monsters there in every level 
- Random sounds was removed 
- If monsters are nearby a quiet one will rush played 
- Performance improves. Now it should run more liquidly. 
- Camara is not broken any more 
- Player runs a little faster
